_comment: Wave D-1 (#155): THE alchemist arc proof. near_mixer fixture (Mixer 9 at the Pallass benches, player_skills empty so the field hotbar is exactly the 3 mixer field grants). PHASE A: three real field-hotbar casts at three co-located benches -- low_grade_synthesis (slot 1) -> crude_draught, magic_water_solvent (slot 2) -> solvent_phial, mineral_distillation (slot 3) -> mineral_salts -- each banks synthesized_draught (66 -> 69). GH#330 R5 leg rides cast 1: a repeat cast against a full pack refuses and banks NOTHING. PHASE B: sleep at the inn levels Mixer 9->10 and evolves it to [Alchemist] (grants [True Synthesis]; the alchemist's own grant sorts to hotbar slot 1, ahead of the inherited mixer grants). PHASE C: the true bench (slot 1) consumes BOTH solvent_phial and mineral_salts (the String|Array requires_item/remove_item seam) and yields tonic_of_the_clear_eye; crude_draught survives. No combat anywhere. Emit order per cast: skill_used -> accomplishment_recorded -> bench toast -> item_gained (the pickup fires AFTER the bench toast; item_lost, if any, fires after the pickup).

steps._comment: #330 R5 THE BENCH CURE, proven here: a SECOND cast with the crude_draught still in the pack refuses BEFORE banking. This produce-only arm used to bank synthesized_draught on a pickup that silently failed, so mashing a full pack carried the [Alchemist] curve with nothing entering the world.

payload_contains.text: Your pack already holds one of those. No sense making a second you cannot carry.

steps._comment: NO BANK: still 67 after the refusal (66 at boot + the one real synthesis above).
== cast 2: step right to (6,8), bump up to face the solvent still (6,7), cast [Magic-Water Solvent] (slot 2).
== cast 3: step right to (7,8), bump up to face the retort (7,7), cast [Mineral Distillation] (slot 3).
== PHASE B: sleep at the inn bed to resolve progression. Teleport upstairs, bump up into your_bed (9,1), interact -> sleep -> Mixer 9->10 (level_up) -> evolve to [Alchemist].

== PHASE C: back to the true bench (8,7). [True Synthesis] is now slot 1 (the alchemist's own grant sorts ahead of the inherited mixer skills). Bump up to face the bench, cast slot 1: it consumes BOTH solvent_phial and mineral_salts (String|Array remove_item) and yields tonic_of_the_clear_eye. Pickup (tonic) fires BEFORE the two item_lost removals.

payload_contains.text: [True Synthesis] — Solvent into salts, in the one order that holds. What settles in the vial is clearer than either half went in.
